preprocessing: Normalize missing schemes as HTTPS and validate HTTP(S) syntax; never fetch URLs.
Derive registrable domains with the bundled Public Suffix List snapshot for split groups.
Remove URLs with conflicting labels; merge exact same-label duplicates and preserve source provenance.
Keep hard negatives in a separate CSV; the trainer assigns registrable domains to fit augmentation or held-out challenge evaluation.

hard_negative_challenge.mining_rule: UCI label=legitimate plus login/signin/verify/security/secure/account/auth/payment/billing/password/support/invoice/banking/identity/portal/sso/checkout/recover/reset/credential/confirm/profile/service/user/customer/member/subscription URL substring OR query length >=40 with >=1 parameter OR >=2 query parameters OR path depth >=4 OR URL length >=110; maximum 5 URLs per registrable domain
hard_negative_challenge.mined_license: CC BY 4.0 inherited from UCI; attribution required
hard_negative_challenge.role: partitioned by registrable domain; fit subset may augment training, held-out subset reports challenge performance; no threshold or model tuning on held-out subset
